sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Poland – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: standard CIT 19%, reduced 9% for small taxpayers, 23% for banks from 2026.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Poland – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: personal income tax 12% up to PLN 120,000 less a deduction of PLN 3,600, then PLN 10,800 plus 32% of the excess.
